name: ade
description: Consort — a branch- and worktree-oriented agentic development environment. Every task gets its own git worktree; Claude Code and Codex agents work there, with PR review, ticket-to-merge shipping, notes and terminals in one desktop app.

scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty && electron-packager . Consort --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.aligned.consort --extend-info=build/Info.plist --out=dist --overwrite --asar=false --prune=true --ignore='^/(src|dist|tests|scripts|\.consort|\.claude|\.npmrc|electron\.vite\.config\.ts|tsconfig\.json)$' && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/Consort-darwin-arm64/Consort.app && echo 'built dist/Consort-darwin-arm64/Consort.app'
scripts.install:mac: pnpm package:mac && (ps -axo args= | grep -q '^/Applications/Consort.app/Contents/MacOS/Consort' && echo 'Quit Consort first: it is running from /Applications' && exit 1 || true) && rm -rf /Applications/Consort.app && ditto dist/Consort-darwin-arm64/Consort.app /Applications/Consort.app && echo 'installed /Applications/Consort.app'
